m15_repair.observations: Visible curved white caption-card remnants restored in F1908–1920; black drip silhouettes remain on FX only. No hidden glyph completion; small disconnected white fragments and strokes connected to ink remain deliberately partial.

observations: Saved overlays were judged independently on neutral backgrounds, not by tautological full-layer reconstruction over the source.
Native F4182 blurred petal no longer carries the glove black line; compression grain/estimated fringes remain.
Native F504 small ghost has transparent eye hole and retained pink body; fine contour grain remains.
Native F3368 giant star retains thin black/brown boundary and is declared above the subtitle track.
Original visible artwork and source videos are not redrawn by this overlay delivery.
limitations: Full-timeline mapping and byte-integrity checks do not prove all subtitles/effects are perfectly separated.
M09/M24 large typography behind characters, M23 glove-contact に and M35 晴/れ retain partial glyphs; hidden parts are not invented.
M07/M16 text shadows are omitted; M08 observed shadow layer is an estimate, not author parameters.
F591 canvas-clipped ghost has no supported pink body, only observed contour: not a complete reusable ghost cel.
Lyrics/shadow occlusion can leave holes in ghost/splash/ray overlays; replacing original lyrics or character occlusion may reveal gaps requiring local repair.
F834–846 orange field has character occlusion holes; F2247 identical gold/ray contact remains ambiguous.
Fine compressed-video grain, minimum-noise fades and same-colour contact areas cannot uniquely recover authored alpha; all mattes are estimated.
No claim of complete hidden artwork, original author alpha, or universally production-clean cels.
release_decision: Deliver observed reusable transparent overlays with explicit partial/ambiguous regions and exact source timing; not a clean-cel reconstruction certificate.
